message.content: {"caption":"A framed prompt panel describing rules for inspecting a chronological SQLite conversation transcript.","description":"A wide, light-gray rectangular panel with a thin blue border. A bold teal heading reads “Prompt 2: SQLite transcript-mode addendum.” Beneath it, a black paragraph states that the transcript is stored as one chronological SQLite turns table; it names conversation_manifest and the read-only conversation_sql_query as tools for deciding how to inspect it. It says the harness does not split the transcript into pages or secretly scan it to build missing-fact lists, asks that memory changes be auditable through cited inspected turn ranges, and cautions against claiming coverage of rows not actually inspected.","figure_type":"other","chart_values":[]}
